title: Case 019: Severe weather suspends the delivery route

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: An operator weather decision suspends the route. The correct task is to relay a verified update and review time, not invent a replacement arrival estimate.
initial_request: I saw the weather alert. Can you tell me whether my parcel is coming today and when I should expect an update?
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask dispatch for its approved disruption update and next scheduled review time.

outcome: The customer receives the verified suspension notice and review time; no unsupported arrival promise is made.
boundaries: A review time is not a route-restart time or guaranteed delivery time.

events.from: Route safety control, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Route MQ-19 is suspended due to severe weather. DL-019 is secure in depot stock. Dispatch will review conditions at 15:00 UTC today; there is no approved delivery estimate.
I saw the weather alert. Can you tell me whether my parcel is coming today and when I should expect an update?
Please provide the approved disruption wording and next review time for DL-019. I need a verified customer update, not an unapproved arrival estimate.
Approved update: the delivery route is suspended and DL-019 remains at the depot. Conditions will be reviewed at 15:00 UTC today. We cannot currently promise delivery today.
Dispatch confirms the route is suspended and your parcel remains at the depot. Its next review is at 15:00 UTC today. No delivery estimate has been approved yet.
